paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Sydney, working at Rapido — the University of Technology Sydney's R&D and engineering consultancy, delivering technology projects for industry partners.

My strengths span full-stack web development, frontend UX, and Linux-based systems engineering — from low-level hardware integration to production web applications. I integrate AI where it delivers measurable value, not as a buzzword.
I thrive at the boundary between systems engineering and product delivery, often stepping into technical leadership when projects need direction.
